title: Development and validation of machine learning models for predicting STAS in stage I lung adenocarcinoma with part-solid and solid nodules: a two-center study.
summary: Original Frontiers Methods/Results: ML models predict STAS in stage-I lung adenocarcinoma using 353-patient training data and independent 120-patient second-center validation; tuning used stratified 10-fold CV in training only. Retrospective multicenter validation; narrow diagnostic prediction. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
